submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image1 into ONE independent full-body game animation frame with native square canvas at least1024x1024 and genuine transparent RGBA. Image1 is edit target: preserve EXACT character identity, face, expression, hair silhouette, camera, head/body scale, current upper torso, costume design, both arms/hands, full long bamboo bow and its string, and right-shoulder quiver. Image2 is the adjacent same-character grounded-leg reference for joint continuity and actual sole contact; DO NOT duplicate its pose. Image3 is the approved primary painting style only, bright clean rounded Taoist chibi ivory/jade/gold hand-painted volumes; do not reproduce UI. Change ONLY pelvis/legs/ankles/boots and immediately affected shorts overlap. Exactly two anatomically connected legs and feet. Preserve image1 full-canvas framing, upper-body root position and scale. No whole-image translation, crop, zoom, mirroring, interpolation or mechanical deformation. LEFT hand always grips complete long bow; RIGHT hand empty. No floor, shadow, effect, text, grid, colored background or watermark. This is a real independently articulated supporting pose in a16frame run, not a repeated frame. Plant the same support boot that is planted in image2; hip-knee-ankle must stay in one continuous load-bearing chain. The sole contact needs a clear flat/broad horizontal contact plane, ankle neutral, toes aligned with running direction, no eversion or outward rotated sole. Do not confuse low dangling foot with weight bearing. WEST screen-left profile unchanged. Fourth consecutive grounded frame of the FIRST stance. Maintain the anatomical LEFT/far stance leg shown in image2. Draw late midstance: support boot flat under the pelvis, toes point screenLEFT, heel still down, knee softly flexed (not locked), pelvis carried directly over this leg. Anatomical RIGHT/near swing knee advances forward while its boot is naturally lifted and separate. Unlike old image1, do not lift the previously planted front foot and replace it with the other trailing foot. The sole meets the same ground level as image2 (abouty965 at1024), actual anatomy must visibly support the body. Keep image1 head/arms/bow unchanged.
